name: Question 7
problem:
Consider the system of equations 

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+8y=-14 \\ 5x+4y=13.\end{aligned}
$$

According to Cramer's rule, $y=$
worked_solution:
We are given the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+8y=-14 \\ 5x+4y=13.\end{aligned}
$$

The determinant of the coefficient matrix is

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =|\begin{aligned}2 & 8 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to construct ${D}_{y}$ we replace the second column of the coefficient matrix by the right-hand side column of the given system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{y} & =|\begin{aligned}2 & -14 \\ 5 & 13\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, according to Cramer's rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\frac{{D}_{y}}{D}=\frac{|\begin{aligned}2 & -14 \\ 5 & 13\end{aligned}|}{|\begin{aligned}2 & 8 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}|}.\end{aligned}
$$
